newsitem.title: DENMARK: Rieber says holds 35.9 pct in Phoenix.
newsitem.headline: Rieber says holds 35.9 pct in Phoenix.

text.p: Norway's Rieber & Son, one of two bidders for Danish roadbuilder Phoenix Contractors, said on Thursday that it had increased its stake to 35.9 percent of Phoenix equity.
Rieber said it now owned 33.7 percent of Phoenix votes.

It previously held 32.6 percent of Phoenix equity but Danish investment company C.W. Opel earlier on Thursday announced it sold its total holding in Phoenix to Rieber without disclosing the size of the stake.
According to a February 28 analysis Opel held 1.6 percent of Phoenix equity and 5.9 percent of votes.

Rieber and rival suitor Icopal have each offered 876 million Danish crowns for Phoenix, comprising 790 crowns per A-share and 710 crowns for the most-traded C-share, its market price at 1345 gmt on Thursday.
Icopal last week said it held 11.23 percent of Phoenix equity.
